question_text: The sum of four consecutive integers is 74. What is the largest?

hint_ladder.title: Maging si x ang smallest
hint_ladder.text: Isipin mo, apat na magkakasunod na numbers ay puwedeng i-represent bilang x, x+1, x+2, x+3. Dito, x ang pinakamaliit.

hint_ladder.title: Isulat ang sum equation
hint_ladder.text: Kapag pinagsama: x+(x+1)+(x+2)+(x+3) = 4x+6. I-set ito sa 74.

hint_ladder.title: Solve mo si x
hint_ladder.text: 4x+6 = 74 → 4x = 68 → x = 17. Tandaan, ito ang pinakamaliit na integer.

hint_ladder.title: Kunin ang pinakamalaki
hint_ladder.text: Dahil x+3 ang huli, 17+3 = 20. Huwag kalimutang basahin ulit ang tanong para sure na largest ang hinihingi.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you stopped after solving for x and got 17, forgetting that the question asks for the largest integer.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you added 1 instead of 3, giving the second integer mistakenly as the largest.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you added 2 instead of 3, landing on the third integer by mistake.

D.text: Correct. Solving 4x+6=74 gives x=17, so the largest integer x+3=20 is the answer.

next_time_rule: For consecutive integers, let the smallest be x. The largest is x + (n-1). Always re-read to answer what is asked—largest, not smallest.
deconstruct_text:
Sa Barangay Masagana, naglaan sila ng magkakasunod na halaga para sa apat na feeding programs. Ang total budget ay ₱74,000. Para mas madali, tawagin nating x ang pinakamaliit na halaga. Kaya ang apat na amounts: x, x+1, x+2, x+3 (in thousands of pesos).

I-set up ang equation: x + (x+1) + (x+2) + (x+3) = 4x + 6 = 74. Subtract 6: 4x = 68. Divide by 4: x = 17. Kaya ang pinakamaliit ay ₱17,000. Ang pinakamalaki ay x+3 = 20, ibig sabihin ₱20,000.

I-check: 17+18+19+20 = 74. Tama! Kaya ang sagot sa tanong na 'What is the largest?' ay 20. Huwag malito sa smallest.

**Watch-Out Zone: order_of_operations_error** in action. Stop at x = smallest, not larg...
